pages.title: Welcome to Create Galore
pages.text: Create Galore is a big, long-term Minecraft pack built around the Create mod. Rotating machines are the core, and everything else hangs off them: airships, submarines, trains, roller coasters, the Moon, survival layers, homesteading and a lot of new world.
**Just spawned?** Read [#](2E5AAC)[Your First Days](entry://start_here/first_days)[#]() before your first night. It covers drinking, clean water, food and staying warm.

This book is a **wiki**, not a quest list. Nothing here tells you what to do next. Each entry explains one idea, how it behaves, the rules that trip people up, and how it connects to the other mods in the pack.

**Reading the pages**\
[#](7A3C9A)[Purple words](entry://glossary/index)[#]() open a definition in Words to Know. [#](2E5AAC)Blue words[#]() open the full entry.\
\
[#](FFFFFF)[#]() **Key points** start a long entry: the must-know part.\
[#](FFFFFF)[#]() **In depth** marks optional detail; all after it can wait.\
\
[#](FFFFFF)[#]() **Watch out:** danger or lost progress\
[#](FFFFFF)[#]() **Tip:** a useful trick

**The sections**
- Start Here
- Create: The Basics
- How Things Connect
- Industry and Power
- Ores and Metals
- Survival Layers
- Trains and Rides

- Flight
- The Road to the Stars
- Space
- The Ocean
- Exploration
- Food and Farming
- Home and Storage

**Reading the maps**\
Each section is a map. An arrow from one entry to another means the first one usually comes before it, so to reach something, follow its lines back. Drag to move around and scroll to zoom.

**Searching**\
The magnifying glass on the right searches the text of every page.\
\
New to Create? [#](2E5AAC)[Rotation](entry://create_basics/rotation)[#]() is the first idea.

**Ask the Book**\
On a home server whose owner gave the book a voice, the **Ask the Book** ribbon (the speech bubble on the right edge of this book) opens pages where you ask in your own words. It answers from this guide, the server's recipes, what is on your screen, what you carry, the chests you have opened nearby and your advancements. Also: /askbook.

**What the book can do**\
It shows recipes, and draws diagrams or builds 3D models you can turn when they help (right-click one to keep it as a page).\
\
Ask why a build doesn't work and it finds the build near you and reads it block by block. It only sees blocks players placed, so it never finds ores or loot, and it never gives map locations.

**Improving your builds**\
Ask it to improve or fix something you built and it copies the build into a 3D model with its changes outlined: green for blocks to add or change, red for blocks to take out.

**Building from a model**\
Hover a 3D model and press **Save as schematic**: it goes into your own schematics folder as a Create schematic. Put an [](item://create:empty_schematic) in a [](item://create:schematic_table), pick the file and you get a [](item://create:schematic) of it, the same as any schematic.

**Tracing it**\
Hold the Schematic and right-click to place it, then move, turn or mirror it with Create's schematic tools (hold Left Alt to pick one). Now put it in your off hand: the build stays shown while you place blocks, each block vanishes once the right one is in its spot, and a wrong block gets a red outline.

**Pinning it for everyone**\
Sneak-right-click a placed Schematic and press **Pin for everyone**. The build stays where it is as faint blocks, with nothing in your hands, and every player on the server sees it. Build over it together: the right block fills its spot, a wrong one turns red. **Unpin** on that screen, or /schematic unpin next to it, takes it down; /schematic list shows every pin.

**Several questions at once**\
You can have it answering on up to three pages at once. When an answer lands on a page you aren't reading, or with the book closed, a notice slides in and the page glows green under All pages until you open it. Until then the Field Guide itself glows green in your hotbar and inventory, and so does the Ask the Book ribbon.

pages.title: The Field Guide
pages.text: You get one on first join. It can be crafted from a Book and Andesite (shapeless), and opened from JEI. See [#](2E5AAC)[Tools of the Trade](entry://start_here/tools)[#]().
